what: Video and photo card cells on the left stack one by one, sticking at screen center below the header row. While the next cell rises from the bottom of the screen and sticks, the previous card recedes to .7× scale and .5 opacity (following the scroll target with a Framer spring of stiffness 728, damping 25, mass 1). Only the text panel of the last cell whose top edge has passed the 55% line stays (the original observes rootMargin −45%, so it is picked every frame to stay correct on reverse scroll too). Its children (eyebrow, title, body, button) rise from 30px below over .9s cubic-bezier(.12,.23,.12,.99) at .06s stagger (max .12s) while the previous panel fades out in .4s. Below 767px it is a plain stacked list with no pinning, receding, or swapping

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cells that stick to the screen (in order) — inside, [data-fx-part=face] is set, only that face shrinks (otherwise the cell itself)
options.[data-fx-part=texts] > [data-fx-part=tex: Per-cell text panels (optional) — stacked in one spot, children rise one by one. Height and center alignment of texts are the user’s css
options.scale · fade: Size and opacity of the receded card, default .7 · .5
options.dur · out · stagger · cap · rise: Text enter duration (.9) · exit duration (.4) · child gap (.06) · gap cap (.12) · rise distance (30px)
options.head: Selector for the header row used to measure the stick position, default header — a cell face sticks at (screen − face − header)/2 + header
options.narrow: Turned off at this width (px) or below, default 767
